newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's JSE says trade resumes after delay.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's JSE says trade resumes after delay.

text.p: The Johannesburg stock exchange said on Wednesday the market had opened for trading at 0957 GMT, following an almost two-and-a-half hour delay during which the electronic trading system was tested.
"The market is open and we are monitoring the system," JSE president Roy Andersen told Reuters.
The system failed twice on Monday after the installation of of new software at the weekend and was again interrupted for an hour on Tuesday.
Andersen said the JSE would release a statement shortly on whether trade would be extended to cover lost time.
